department: Department of Mathematics and Computer Science

deadline.value: Fall 2027 deadline is March 1, 2027 for non-U.S. applicants (June 1, 2027 for U.S. applicants).

gre_subject.value: The Mathematical Sciences Ph.D. page does not state a GRE Subject Test in Mathematics requirement.

supervisor.value: The Mathematical Sciences Ph.D. page does not state whether a supervisor must be secured before admission.

funding.value: The Mathematical Sciences Ph.D. page does not state funding or assistantship guarantees.

entry_route.value: Students may enter with a bachelor's degree (typically spending two years on coursework before qualifying exams) or with an advanced degree where equivalent coursework may be waived.
entry_route.quote: Individuals entering with a bachelor's degree normally spend their first two years in coursework and in preparation for the Ph.D. qualifying examination. | The above course requirements can be waived, however, for students with advanced degrees who have completed equivalent coursework.

notes: Ph.D. in Mathematical Sciences curriculum is formally divided into two options: pure mathematics and data science (including machine learning and AI training), so also_fields includes datasci.
